prompt: The cat stands relaxed facing the camera, breathing gently, blinks twice, tail sways slowly side to side, a tiny head tilt and a small weight shift, then returns exactly to the relaxed standing pose. Very subtle idle motion.

The cat raises its right arm and points clearly toward the left side of the frame as if presenting something off-screen, turns its head to look that way with an excited smile, gives a small nod, then lowers the arm and returns to the relaxed standing pose facing the camera.

The cat puts one paw on its chin, tilts its head, looks up to the side thoughtfully with a small hmm expression, taps the chin twice, then lowers the paw and returns to the relaxed standing pose facing the camera.

The cat sits cross-legged with a small light-blue laptop on its lap and types quickly with both paws, pauses to lean in and check the screen with a focused face, then resumes typing. Seamless loop, ends in the same sitting typing pose as the start.

The cat waits impatiently: looks off to the side as if watching a loading screen, taps one foot, tail flicks twice, lets out a small bored sigh with half-closed eyes, then straightens up into the relaxed standing pose facing the camera.
The cat is suddenly surprised: eyes go wide, it hops back a little with both paws up and mouth open in a small gasp, then relaxes and returns to the relaxed standing pose facing the camera.

The cat jumps for joy with both arms raised high and a happy closed-eye smile, lands and does one more small happy bounce with sparkly eyes, then settles back into the relaxed standing pose facing the camera.

The cat leans forward slightly and squints as if inspecting something very closely, slowly scans left and right with its head like reading a screen, gives a satisfied nod, then returns to the relaxed standing pose facing the camera.

The cat notices a mistake: flinches, ears droop, a small sweat drop appears, paws come up near its face in a flustered way with wide worried eyes, then it shakes it off and returns to the relaxed standing pose facing the camera.

The cat waves goodbye at the camera with a big smile, then turns and walks off toward the right side with a bouncy step, exiting the frame completely so only the empty green background remains at the end.
